issues.issue: Should the new evidence (German Consulate letter and affidavit) be admitted at the RAD stage?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant requests admission of two new documents; no explanation for not obtaining letter earlier; no argument on affidavit compliance.
issues.respondent_position: Ministry initially sought German contact; letter credible and admissible; affidavit inadmissible as no new info.
issues.result_text: German Consulate letter admitted; affidavit inadmissible.

issues.issue: Should the RAD hold a hearing on the new evidence?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant requests hearing arguing affidavit evidence warrants it and RPD did not address credibility.
issues.respondent_position: RAD proceeds without hearing unless conditions met; affidavit inadmissible; letter does not justify hearing.
issues.result_text: No hearing needed as affidavit inadmissible and letter insufficient to justify hearing.

issues.issue: Is the appellant excluded from refugee protection under Article 1E due to permanent residency in Germany?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant argues not resident of Germany; documents except passport were forgeries.
issues.respondent_position: RPD found permanent residency based on documents; visa officials accepted documents as authentic.
issues.result_text: Appellant did not have permanent residency; RPD erred in exclusion finding.

issues.issue: Is the appellant credible given the passport discrepancies and alleged fraudulent modifications?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant claims valid passport given to agent; denies travel outside Turkey before Canada; argues visa officials fooled but documents not genuine.
issues.respondent_position: RPD found two passport versions; modifications to hide travel; fraudulent modification undermines credibility.
issues.result_text: Appellant lacks credibility due to fraudulent passport modifications and fabricated testimony.

issues.issue: Will the appellant face persecution or harm in Turkey as an Alevi Muslim?
issues.applicant_position: Appellant claims persecution risk due to political opinion and religion.
issues.respondent_position: Alevis face some discrimination but not persecution; UK Home Office summary supports no serious harm.
issues.result_text: Appellant will not face serious possibility of persecution or harm in Turkey.
